findings.claim_text: Grok 4.6 is priced at $2 per million input tokens and $6 per million output against Claude Fable 5 Max at $10/$50 — an 80% discount on input and 88% on output.
Parametric CAD Bench measured Grok 4.6 at 96.9% of Claude Opus 5's top score of 0.906 for 61% of the cost — the claim that the repricing survives non-vendor cost-aware benchmarks.
findings.contradicting_quote: The single third-party number anyone cited — Frontend Arena, 1,553 points — places Grok 4.6 13th, which is not a frontier-leading position and sits awkwardly beside a table asserting parity with GPT-5.6 Sol. The CAD result is single-operator, covers one engineering domain, and was published inside the seven-day promotional window.

findings.claim_text: Artificial Analysis puts Grok 4.6 at 61 on its Intelligence Index against Fable 5 Max's 62 — the near-parity that anchors the frontier-repricing thesis.
findings.contradicting_quote: On really long-running and autonomous workflows … the best OpenAI and Anthropic models are much better in the tails — a composite index cannot capture the tail-reliability gap where Fable 5 Max's premium is most defensible.
